insight: Began as an AI PDF/document reader, then pivoted to a unified work OS; raised a $9.3M seed led by Andreessen Horowitz.
name: Macro
description: Macro is a workspace that folds email, messages, documents, tasks, calls, and a lightweight CRM into one interface, with AI agents that share full workspace context. Documents use CRDTs for instant, offline-capable collaborative editing, and a unified inbox pulls in email and GitHub pull requests. It markets itself as faster than Superhuman, quieter than Slack, and simpler than Notion.

modelSupport.notes: Uses models from Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google; zero data retention with providers.

edge: Folds email, docs, tasks, calls and a CRM into one open-source workspace where AI agents share full context across all of it.
pros: Unifies email, docs, tasks, CRM, calls
SOC 2 Type II; zero data retention
cons: Free plan adds a 'Sent with Macro' signature

references.title: Macro raises $9.3M to layer intelligence on top of digital documents
